about_the_game:
Outfit Enzo with an ornate arsenal and accoutrements befitting a godfather. The Padrino Pack includes special weapons, cosmetic items, and a Charm that provides a passive in-game effect.*

The Padrino Pack contains:

• "Lupara Speciale" Shotgun

• "Vendetti Speciale" Pistol

• "Immortale" Charm

• "Padrino" Outfit

• "Stiletto Speciale" Knife

• "Eckhart Speciale" Limousine

• "Cosimo" Horse and Accessories

*Internet connection and base game required. The Padrino Pack is included in the Deluxe Edition of Mafia: The Old Country.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Intense Violence or Gore, Suggestive Themes, Strong Language, General Mature Content.
